source: registered sparse observed 500ms public-trade bars, January-June 2023

information_unit.state: completed common five-second state with fresh last trade no older than two seconds
information_unit.fit_normalization: January-February median absolute ten-second log return per symbol
information_unit.shock_threshold: pooled January-February upper quartile of absolute normalized ten-second return
information_unit.event: exactly two markets share a same-sign shock while the third has the same sign but less than one-third of the leader-median normalized displacement
information_unit.rearm: three-market normalized dispersion below its January-February median

action.side: trade the laggard in the two-market consensus direction
action.entry: first observed 500ms bucket after fixed 500ms activation
action.target: laggard itself moves at least half the frozen gap in the consensus direction and closes at least half the relative gap
action.state_loss: relative gap extends another half or completed leader consensus reverses
